per_execution: Stop accepted when one bound candidate passes every applicable frozen gate

Stop censored at 120 implementation active minutes, 240 total active operator minutes, 8 wall-clock hours excluding declared shared outage, 4 HIGH or 2 LOW candidates, or 2 rework loops, whichever occurs first
Safety/destructive behavior stops immediately and is retained as failure
No discretionary extra candidate, repair, time, or reordered gate
study: Complete all non-excluded randomized pairs; do not stop for apparent support, futility, or effect size
Administrative stop only for authorization withdrawal, integrity breach, >20% eligible executions affected by a common harness/environment defect, or inability to realize HIGH abundance
A common defect pauses collection before any repair; affected observations are quarantined and protocol amendment requires a new version, never silent continuation
evidence_lock: Hash task contract, starting commit, gates, environment, randomization, model/configuration, and analysis code before execution. Freeze dataset before unblinding condition aggregates.
